questions.question: Look at Card 1 ((4+5)/4). Which statement about steps (1)–(4) is correct?
questions.figure_spec: Neat 3-step card for (4+5)/4: (1) wrong cancel with pen cuts, (2) right methods, (3) four steps to judge.
questions.method_hint: If the numerator is a sum/difference, split the fraction or factor first. Cancel only a common factor of the whole top and bottom.
questions.explanation: The bar means the whole numerator is divided by 4. So (4+5)/4 = 4/4 + 5/4 = 9/4, not 5. True: [2, 3]. False: [1, 4]. Result: 9/4. Final answer = option C

questions.question: Look at Card 2 ((44+11)/11). Which statement about steps (1)–(4) is correct?
questions.figure_spec: Neat 3-step card for (44+11)/11: (1) wrong cancel with pen cuts, (2) right methods, (3) four steps to judge.
options: Steps (1) and (4) are wrong; only (2) is correct
questions.method_hint: If the numerator is a sum/difference, split the fraction or factor first. Cancel only a common factor of the whole top and bottom.
questions.explanation: 11 divides the whole sum. Correct: 55/11 = 5, or 44/11 + 11/11 = 5. Never 45. True: [2, 3]. False: [1, 4]. Result: 5. Final answer = option C
